uses.quote: You are not permitted to use generative AI tools such as ChatGPT during the class unless your tutor expressly authorises this for a particular seminar task.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI and other AI tools in the classroom

uses.quote: You may use GenAI tools as part of your seminar preparation, provided that you do not use it to generate answers to seminar questions.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI and other AI tools in the classroom

uses.quote: You are not permitted to use live translation or live transcription software that translates the seminar discussion or lecture as it happens.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI and other AI tools in the classroom

uses.quote: You are not permitted to use live translation or live transcription software that translates the seminar discussion or lecture as it happens.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI and other AI tools in the classroom

uses.quote: If English is not your first language, you are allowed to use a translation tool that does not involve voice recording or voice capture other than your own to help you formulate your response during the seminar if you are unsure about the right wording.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI and other AI tools in the classroom

uses.quote: the Law School prohibits copying/paraphrasing either whole outputs or elements of outputs generated by a GenAI system and submitted by students as their own work.
uses.anchor: Academic Integrity

uses.quote: even where the use of GenAI systems is not prohibited, the Law School discourages the use of such outputs even with correct and complete attribution.
uses.anchor: Academic Integrity

uses.quote: the use of AI to complete certain parts of an assessment, such as analysis or evaluation, is not permitted.
uses.anchor: Academic Integrity

uses.quote: However, it must never be used to create the work, or certain parts of the work, for you. You must not submit any AI-generated output as your own work.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Unless expressly required for a specific assessment task, Warwick Law School does not encourage the use of GenAI tools for assessments.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Note that any use of GenAI may be prohibited for specific assessment tasks. This might be the case e.g., where the assessment tests your key legal or academic skills.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Students should be aware that GenAI tools can weaken the quality of your work – particularly if you rely on GenAI for accuracy, relevance and rigour.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask questions to GenAI to check your understanding of your assessment question
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask GenAI to suggest an outline of the essay you are going to write, based on the points you provide to it.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask GenAI to check the grammar, flow, consistency, language, tone and style of the essay.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Use GenAI as a search engine/database to find further sources.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask GenAI to summarise the content of academic articles, books, reports or other sources, although if the work is relevant to your research, you should then read it in full.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask GenAI to provide feedback on the project you wrote, before submitting it.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask GenAI to generate some ideas, arguments, examples from scratch.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students

uses.quote: Ask GenAI to rewrite any part of your essay.
uses.anchor: Permitted and prohibited uses of GenAI – Guidance to Students
